name: LIDC-IDRI
description: A publicly available collection of thoracic CT scans annotated for lung nodules by multiple radiologists, supporting research in nodule detection and characterization. Images and annotations are not vendored.
citation: Armato, S. G. III, et al. (2011). The Lung Image Database Consortium (LIDC) and Image Database Resource Initiative (IDRI): A completed reference database of lung nodules on CT scans. Medical Physics, 38(2), 915-931. https://doi.org/10.1118/1.3528204
